description: Identify a software / content licence from a LICENSE file, source header or SPDX expression and explain what it allows: 40 licences incl. MIT, Apache-2.0, BSD-2/3/4, ISC, 0BSD, GPL/LGPL/AGPL v2/v3, MPL-2.0, EPL, EUPL, Unlicense, CC0, Creative Commons BY/SA/NC/ND, and source-available BUSL / SSPL / Elastic / PolyForm / Commons Clause. Returns SPDX id, confidence, category (permissive, weak / strong / network copyleft, non-commercial, source-available), OSI approval, permissions / conditions / limitations, "or later" detection, SPDX-License-Identifier tags and copyright holders. Offline; not legal advice. Price: $0.002 USDC per successful call (x402, Solana). Same tool over HTTPS: POST https://scorptech.it.com/api/x402/v1/license-detect
